name: Projection Drift Detection Metric
purpose: Detect when projection language drifts toward primitive ontology, physical interpretation, arithmetic replacement, or unification claims.

metrics.definition: Detects use of projection outcomes as if they were irreducible framework primitives.
metrics.calculation: keyword match density in claim text

metrics.definition: Detects physical-theory terms (energy, force, particle) applied to projection analogs without 'like' or 'analog' qualifiers.
Detects language implying that a projection IS the source relation rather than a mapping OF it.
metrics.calculation: density of identity verbs in bridge analysis

metrics.definition: Detects early escalation to unification or physical law derivation.
Detects claims that projection coherence proves the source relation is now fully understood or recovered.

governance_rules.rule: Any drift score exceeding the BLOCK threshold triggers automatic REJECT_ESCALATION.
Drift detection is mandatory for all C4+ claim submissions involving bridges.

forbidden_claims: Linguistic drift does not impact technical validity.
Implicit unification is permitted if metrics are high.
